dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) free-format source; part of Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) by Vincent B. Coen, migrated to Open Cobol in 2009, updated for v3.02 in 2018
evidence: 'Migration to Open Cobol' in change log
copy wsnames.cob / wscall.cob / wssystem.cob pattern typical of ACAS/GnuCOBOL

purpose.domain_detail: General Ledger transaction pre-processing and batch status reporting for the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS)
purpose.summary: This program (gl070) performs two phases: first it checks batch status for the current cycle and reports open batches, then it pre-processes GL transactions from the posting file into a pre-transaction sequential file. It also displays a batch status report with ledger, batch, status, dates, items, gross and VAT figures.

notable_features: Screen I/O with DISPLAY/ACCEPT at line/col
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed records (wscall, wssystem, wsnames, file-defs)
VAT handling in transaction splitting (DR/CR sides)
MULTIPLY pre-amount BY -1 for credit entries
BLANK WHEN ZERO on numeric display fields
High comment ratio (~40%) with structured change log
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; full file is 17916 bytes/592 lines. The zz060-Convert-Date and zz070-convert-date sections are referenced but only partially visible. No COMP-3 usage despite financial amounts — amounts stored as DISPLAY numeric. GPL v2 licensed open-source accounting system.
